ActionExists: Name of this action already exists

BestUsedRightSide: Best used with right side as a mouse function
BTPollRate: Determines the poll rate used for the DS4 hardware when connected via Bluetooth. (Applies on profile save)
CannotMoveFiles: Cannot move files to new location, Please rename the DS4Tool folder to "PhantomPad"
CannotWriteHere: Cannot write at current location. Copy Settings to appdata?
CloseConfirm: This will disconnect all your connected controllers. Proceed?
CloseMinimize: Closing main window minimizes app. Quitting app will be done via the notification icon
ControllerWasRemoved: Controller *Mac address* was removed or lost connection
CopyComplete: Copy complete, please relaunch PhantomPad and remove settings from Program Directory
CopyFullColor: Click to copy the full color
CouldNotOpenDS4: Warning: Could not open DS4 *Mac address* exclusively.
DS4WindowsCannotEditHere: PhantomPad cannot edit settings here, This will now close
FlashAtTip: Click to change flash color. Black = default color
FlushHIDTip: Flush HID Queue after each reading
GyroReadout: Click to see readout of Sixaxis Gyro
GyroTriggerBehavior: Check to have gyro active while trigger is active. Uncheck to disable gyro while trigger is active.
HoverOverItems: Hover over items to see description or more about
IfRemovingDS4Windows: If removing PhantomPad, You can delete the settings following the profile folder link
Jitter: Use Sixaxis to help calculate touchpad movement
KeepThisSize: Keep this window size after closing
LanguagePackApplyRestartRequired: Language changed. Some texts will update after restarting PhantomPad.
LightByBatteryTip: Also dim light by idle timeout if enabled when DS4 is fully charged
NotUsingProfile: Controller {0} is not using a profile. Battery level is {1}%
OtherFileLocation: , other location files will be deleted
PleaseDownloadUpdater: Please Download the Updater now, place it in the programs folder and rename to DS4Updater.exe if on x86, then check for update again. PhantomPad will attempt to open DS4Updater Release page when this window is closed.
PleaseImport: Please import or make a profile
ProfileFolderMoved: Profile Folder Moved to program folder
QuickCharge: Auto-Disable BT when connecting to USB
QuitOtherPrograms: You must quit other applications like UWP apps (Netflix), Steam, Uplay, Edge, NVIDIA IN-GAME before activating the 'Hide DS4 Controller' option. For more info check https://github.com/Ryochan7/PhantomPad/wiki/Exclusive-Mode-(Hide-DS4-Controller-config-option)-tips-and-issues
RightClickPresets: Right Click to set presets for a set of controls
RunAtStartup: Tells Windows to start PhantomPad after login

UsingProfile: Controller {0} is using Profile "{1}". Battery level is {2}%

EnableTouchToggle: Allow touchpad mouse function to get toggled with PS + Touchpad Click.

AutoProfilePathAndWindowTitleEditTip: ^ABC = Match at the beginning of string (^) | ABC$ = Match at the end of string ($) | *ABC =Contains a string (*)
ShowAutoProfileDebugLogTip: If enabled then Log tab page shows detailed messages of auto-profile events.
MacroScanCodeTip: Use a scan code value of keyboard keys in a macro
MacroRunOnReleaseTip: Run a macro on the trigger key release
MacroSynchronizedRunTip: Run multiple macros in synchronized order if the same trigger has several macros (key down macro completed before key release macro is run)
MacroRepeatTip: Repeat a macro while the trigger key is held down
MacroKeepKeyStateTip: Keep the last key state when macro execution is completed (ie. if a key is left in down state then it is not automatically reset back to default state)
XMLActionsCorrupt: Actions.xml file was corrupt. Starting from scratch.
OscServer: Enable OSC Server. Listen to port on all addresses.
